Senior Python Backend Engineer | REMOTE (EMEA/APAC)

If you found it interesting, join Reef Technologies and tackle complex technical challenges like this on your own terms:

You need to live in the USA and be a US citizen, Green Card holder, or sole owner of your own LLC company.

Noricum | Senior Backend Engineer, Payments, Ledger & Provable Fairness | REMOTE (2h overlap with US Pacific) | Contract to permanent | $120-160/hr | Start by 14 Sep

I'm the founder of Noricum where we build platforms - currently the money infrastructure, ledger, engine and payment rails behind a pre-launch wagering platform. The games, a cashier and a bet ledger are built and live as a front end, with written specs for the server contract: ledger schema, refusal table, round lifecycle, every game's arithmetic. The server does not exist. That is the job. You would own: A server-authoritative game engine; A double-entry ledger where balance is derived and no client write can change it; Server-side enforcement of every limit and refusal; Payment rails idempotent under duplicated webhooks; An affiliate system with referral attribution and commission payouts

Must have shipped: a double-entry ledger or equivalent money system in production, a payment integration including webhook idempotency, auth and sessions you built and operated, and infrastructure you owned end to end.

ODK | Senior Product Manager | Remote (Worldwide) | Long-term contract, 30-40 hours/week | $90-110/hour USD

ODK is an open-source platform used by thousands of organizations worldwide to collect billions of data points for disease surveillance, supply chain traceability, environmental monitoring, and more. It enables users to build powerful forms and reliably collect structured data, even in places with little or no Internet connectivity.

ODK has been actively developed for 18 years. We have a mix of self-hosted and SaaS users across many sectors. We're looking for a senior product manager who will own product discovery and prioritization across this diverse user base. To be successful, you'll need to find the common needs behind very different workflows and turn them into opinionated product improvements.

Hiring contract software engineers for three roles: Software Engineer, Autonomy; Software Engineer, Perception; Software Engineer, Frontend (HMI)
